result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall; the only notable issue is duplicated content in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (two identical Green Bowl Poké cards side by side).

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first two cards are exact duplicates: both show 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same dish image, '15-25 min' estimate and '€0.90 delivery' fee, placed side by side.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the listing results (or clearly differentiate the two entries, e.g. by branch name/address) so the carousel shows distinct restaurants.
